items.tldr: OpenAI tells investors annualized revenue is nearing $50B, not the $70B in press reports
items.tldr_zh: OpenAI 向投资人称年化收入接近 500 亿美元，比媒体流传的 700 亿少了约 200 亿
items.take: A $20B discrepancy and nobody blushes — in valuation stories, is a number measured, or needed?
items.take_zh: 一个数字能差 200 亿还没人尴尬——
里，数字是测量出来的，还是被需要出来的？

items.tldr: CMS runs a 1,700-member Slack with Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic shaping AI health policy
items.tldr_zh: 美国 CMS 有个 1700 人的 Slack 群，微软、OpenAI、Anthropic 都在里面，参与塑造 AI 医疗政策
items.take: Regulator and regulated in one chat — transparency, or the minimum viable product of capture?

items.tldr: Study: higher cognitive ability links to weaker endorsement of all six moral foundations
items.tldr_zh: 研究：认知能力越高，对六大道德基础的认同反而越弱
items.take: Do smarter people rationalize morality better, or dismantle it better? What sits between thinking more and doing better?
items.take_zh: 更聪明的人更会给道德找理由，还是更会拆掉理由？
